## 2. Segment results

Table 1. Segment revenue and margin.

| Segment | Revenue ($m) | Margin (%) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hardware | 412.5 | 18.2 |
| Software | 288.0 | 41.7 |
| Services | 196.3 | 22.9 |
| Licensing | 74.8 | 63.1 |

Segment profit grew in every quarter of the fiscal year, led by the northern territories where the new distribution centre opened in March. Operating margin improved by two points as freight costs normalised and the product mix shifted towards higher-value subscriptions.
